display.purpose: View titles over the field; Theory chapter titles go larger and wider (clamp(40px, 6vw, 76px), width 125%).

headline.purpose: Theory section headings; the hand name in the hand plate and the feedback grade head sit at this level.

title.purpose: Theory sub-headings, stat figures, action block labels.

body.purpose: UI copy on plates, about 62ch, tabular figures.

label.purpose: Sentence-case control and plate labels; no tracking, no caps.

shadows.name: plate-hairline
shadows.purpose: Edge of plates, trainer tables, examples and steps. A border, not a shadow.

shadows.name: ink-rule
shadows.purpose: Segmented rails, ghost buttons, playing cards, formula boxes.

shadows.name: appbar-rule
shadows.purpose: The heavy ink line closing the app bar.

motion.name: ease-op
motion.purpose: Seg thumb slide (0.34s), lens settle (0.35s), disc sweep-in (0.6s), logo disc scale (0.5s).

motion.name: lens-follow
motion.purpose: Disc scale and label clip while the pointer moves over a grid; up to 1.42x with Gaussian falloff.

motion.name: sweep-stagger
motion.purpose: Diagonal entrance of the discs when a range loads.

motion.name: control-fade
motion.purpose: Colour and background changes on tabs, chips, buttons, action blocks.

motion.name: ground-ripple
motion.purpose: Grade ring through the gutter dot field.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Ground draws one still frame, no ripples, no lens, no sweep or clip transitions, no logo scale, no feedback marker toss.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid ink rectangle for the main action; turns ultramarine on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink, #15161d); color: var(--surface, #fbfbfd); border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 9px 18px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, color .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ultra, #2430d8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ultra, #2430d8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent rectangle ruled in ink for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #15161d); border: 0; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--ink, #15161d); padding: 9px 18px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(21,22,29,.07); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ultra, #2430d8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Rail
components.description: Every option visible as a ghost inside an ink-ruled rail; the chosen one struck in ink (in the build an ink thumb slides to it).
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--ink, #15161d); background: transparent; } .ds-seg button { border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: none; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted, #565c6d); cursor: pointer; transition: color .25s, background .34s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-seg button:hover { color: var(--ink, #15161d); } .ds-seg button.ds-seg-on { background: var(--ink, #15161d); color: var(--surface, #fbfbfd); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ultra, #2430d8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Seat and option chips: hairline ghost, struck in ink when chosen.
components.css: .ds-chip { border: 1px solid var(--line, #c9cdd8); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-2, #343846); padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, color .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--surface, #fbfbfd); color: var(--ink, #15161d); border-color: var(--ink, #15161d); } .ds-chip-on, .ds-chip-on:hover { background: var(--ink, #15161d); border-color: var(--ink, #15161d); color: var(--surface, #fbfbfd); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ultra, #2430d8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Action Blocks
components.description: Trainer answers as enamel blocks: fold ruled in ink, call ultramarine, raise magenta; the picked one gets the orange selection outline.
components.css: .ds-act { flex: 1; min-width: 100px; padding: 14px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Anybody', 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-stretch: 115%; font-weight: 750; font-size: 17px; transition: opacity .2s; } .ds-act:hover { opacity: .9; } .ds-fold { background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #15161d); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--ink, #15161d); } .ds-call { background: var(--ultra, #2430d8); color: #fff; } .ds-raise { background: var(--magenta, #d8226a); color: #fff; } .ds-picked { outline: 3px solid var(--orange, #ff9a1f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-act:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ultra, #2430d8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Plate
components.description: Flat white reading plate on the op-white ground, edged by a hairline; tiles inside sit in op-white.
components.html:
This spot

The best seat at the table: you act last on every street.

0.3%of all starting hands
components.css: .ds-plate { background: var(--surface, #fbfbfd); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(21,22,29,.07); padding: 20px; display: grid; gap: 14px; max-width: 320px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #15161d); } .ds-plate p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-2, #343846); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #15161d); } .ds-tile { background: var(--bg, #eef0f5); padding: 12px; display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-tile b { font-family: 'Anybody', sans-serif; font-stretch: 118%; font-weight: 800; font-size: 18px; } .ds-tile span { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted, #565c6d); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Range-string and number input: white field, 1.5px ink border, square corners.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--surface, #fbfbfd); color: var(--ink, #15161d); border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #15161d); border-radius: 0; padding: 9px 10px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; caret-color: var(--magenta, #d8226a); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ultra, #2430d8); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Range Field Units
components.description: Plastic units: square cells holding a disc whose area is the frequency (radius = sqrt(share)); white label clipped to the disc, ink label beneath; orange outline on the selected unit.
components.html:
AAAA
Q3sQ3s
87o87o
72o72o
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 56px); gap: 3px; } .ds-u { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, var(--c, #d8226a) 0 calc(var(--b) * 88%), transparent calc(var(--b) * 88% + 1px)), var(--surface, #fbfbfd); color: var(--ink, #15161d); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; transition: scale .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-u:hover { scale: 1.12; } .ds-inv { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fff; clip-path: circle(calc(var(--b) * 44%) at 50% 50%); } .ds-sel { outline: 3px solid var(--orange, #ff9a1f); z-index: 1; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-u { transition: none; } .ds-u:hover { scale: 1; } }

components.name: Feedback Plate with Op Target
components.description: Grade plate ruled 2px in the grade colour, its marker a disc with concentric white rings.
components.html:
Mistake

You chose 3-bet, but the chart never does that with 43o here. Always fold.
components.css: .ds-fb { background: var(--surface, #fbfbfd); border: 2px solid var(--magenta, #d8226a); border-radius: 0; padding: 16px 18px; display: grid; gap: 12px; max-width: 340px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-fb p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-2, #343846); } .ds-fb-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: 'Anybody', sans-serif; font-stretch: 118%; font-weight: 800; font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: -.015em; color: var(--ink, #15161d); } .ds-dot { width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: repeating-radial-gradient(circle, transparent 0 2.5px, rgba(255,255,255,.85) 2.5px 4px), var(--magenta, #d8226a); }

components.name: Card Back
components.description: Concentric-ring op target on a square card with a white margin and ink edge.
components.css: .ds-back { width: 56px; height: 78px; border-radius: 0; background: repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, var(--ultra, #2430d8) 0 3px, var(--surface, #fbfbfd) 3px 6px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--surface, #fbfbfd), inset 0 0 0 4.5px var(--ink, #15161d); }

narrative.overview:
The 169 starting hands already form an op-art field; 169 Poker draws them as one. Every hand is a plastic unit: a sharp square holding a disc whose area is the frequency the hand is played. The visitor sees the range as a pattern first and reads it second. Colour lives in the fields (the discs, the action blocks, the bars); text sits on calm, achromatic plates of white or op-white, so reading never fights the pattern.

The world is light, cool and exact. Every corner is square; circles are the only curves, and they always carry meaning (a frequency, a grade, a card back, a chapter number). Controls show every option at once as a ghost, and the chosen one is struck in solid ink. Motion belongs to the field: discs swell under the pointer like a lens, the page gutters breathe as a slow dot field, and a graded answer sends a ring through that field in the grade's colour. Under reduced motion, all of it holds still.

The world rejects the dark poker-felt study tool it replaces: no felt, no wood, no glow, no rounded casino chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Cool op-white ground, white reading plates, near-black ink.
Two field colours with fixed meaning: ultramarine calls, magenta raises.
Orange appears only to mark the current selection.
All corners sharp; circles are the only curves.
Ghost-and-struck controls: options outlined or bare, the chosen one solid ink.
Wide, heavy Anybody display over Hanken Grotesk reading text.
Flat plates separated by tone and hairlines, never by shadow.
A living ground: lens, breathing gutter dots, grade ripples; still under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Field Colour Rule
rules.body: Ultramarine means call, magenta means raise, everywhere they appear as fills. A button, bar or disc in either colour is making that claim.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange marks the current selection and nothing else. It is never a fill for content, a heading or a decoration.

rules.name: The Achromatic Plate Rule
rules.body: Text plates are white or op-white. Colour belongs to the fields and to thin rules; it does not tint reading surfaces.

rules.name: The Wide Ink Rule
rules.body: Display type is Anybody, wide and heavy, and only for titles, hand names, grades and figures. Never set reading copy in it.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case with normal tracking. No all-caps, no letter-spaced labels.

rules.name: The No-Cast-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. Plates sit on the ground and are separated from it by tone and a hairline.

rules.name: The Only-Circles Rule
rules.body: A shape is either a square-cornered rectangle or a true circle. No pills, no rounded rectangles.

dos: Do encode frequency as disc area (radius = square root of the share) in any range or frequency view.
Do use ultramarine for call and magenta for raise on every fill that means an action.
Do strike the chosen option in solid ink and leave the others visible as ghosts.
Do keep reading text on plate white or op-white, in ink, ink soft or muted.
Do keep every corner square and reserve circles for things that mean something.
Do use orange only for the current selection.
Do give every new animation a still state under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use pills or rounded rectangles; corners are 0px, curves are full circles.
Don't cast shadows or lift elements on hover; depth is tone plus hairline.
Don't tint text plates with the field colours.
Don't set body copy in Anybody, or labels in all caps or letter-spacing.
Don't use dim for anything a player needs to read.
Don't let the gutter field enter the content band.
